title: Clean Your Mess
description: A surreal, decaying room with peeling walls features a large broom sweeping vibrant paint spills across the floor. A green banner reading 'CLEAN YOUR MESS' hangs on the left while an ornate circular doorway and multiple open portals reveal glowing interiors. Scattered photographs and paint splatters cover the damaged floor under dramatic spotlight illumination.
prompt: Surreal decaying room interior with peeling paint on the walls, a giant broom sweeping colorful paint across the floor, green fabric banner with text 'CLEAN YOUR MESS' on the left wall, ornate circular doorway with spiral patterns, multiple open doorways revealing glowing purple and red interiors, scattered torn photographs on the ground, dramatic yellow spotlight from upper right casting long shadows, chaotic and artistic atmosphere
